selection_rule.eligible_for_followup: variant must pass both point type-I <= 0.10 and power >= 0.80 on all frozen cells
selection_rule.if_none_pass: do not open empirical SNP outcomes; redesign estimator/null

conclusion: No tested small-panel variant qualifies. Cross-fit increases power but invalidates point type-I control on the frozen Iranian geometry; single-split edge-length IBD residualization controls point type I but is underpowered. Empirical SNP outcomes remain sealed.
